title: Protein crowders remodel RNA electrostatics, hydration, and dynamics: a challenge to steric crowding models

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Read the full open-access text (98 KB) including the data availability statement and the complete methods. Searched the whole text for repository links (Zenodo, GitHub, figshare, Dryad, OSF): zero hits. The automated Zenodo/Dryad search on the DOI returned nothing. Europe PMC's supplementary-files endpoint failed twice (DNS error, then read timeout at 120 s), so the supplement itself is not retrievable; no data files exist to open.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The simulation inventory, all of it from the methods text: one 52-nucleotide HIV-1 TAR RNA construct built from PDB entry 1ANR, in five production runs (one dilute 1 microsecond, two with polyethylene glycol 2 microseconds each, two with protein crowders 4 microseconds each), frames saved every 5 picoseconds, plus ten 500-nanosecond equilibration boxes used only to pick two starting configurations. Crowder composition (72 polyethylene glycol 6000 molecules, or 19 protein copies of four human proteins) and all reported numbers (60% drop in sodium condensation, etc.) are read from the text and figures, not from files.

a1_downloadable.note: FIRST KILLER. Data availability says only 'available in the article and in its online supplementary material' — figures plus supplementary tables of force-field parameters and system sizes. No trajectories, no analysis tables, no code are deposited anywhere; the full text contains no Zenodo, GitHub, figshare, Dryad or OSF link, and a DOI search of Zenodo/Dryad found nothing. The supplement endpoint also failed, so even the tables are not retrievable here.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Nothing resembling a prediction target exists as a column. Every quantity (sodium ion occupancy, hydration-water residence time, radius of gyration, contact number) would have to be computed by us from trajectories we do not have.

a3_inputs_present.note: The only inputs are one RNA sequence and four AlphaFold DB protein accessions (P62269, P13693, P62829, P68363). Atomic coordinates over time, which are the actual input any model would need, are absent.

a4_units_stated.note: Units are stated carefully throughout the methods (g/l crowder concentration, mM salt, K, nm, ns). This is the one Part A item the paper passes cleanly, but it applies to text, not to files.

a5_enough_rows.note: The independent unit is a simulation box, and there are five production trajectories of a single RNA molecule. Treating saved frames (~5 million across all runs) as rows would be fake replication: they are autocorrelated snapshots of one system.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; all-atom trajectories of a ~4,373 nm^3 crowded box saved every 5 ps would be hundreds of gigabytes if they existed
a6_fits_laptop.note: Not assessable because no files are released, but the implied working set for crowded all-atom trajectories is far over the 5 GB limit, and regenerating them needs microseconds of GPU-months of molecular dynamics.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Cannot be checked at all: there is no download whose counts could agree or disagree with the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any label here would be an output of the simulation itself, i.e. computed from the same force field that generated the features. That is leakage by construction plus circularity: a model would learn AMBER ff14SB/OL3 with CUFIX corrections, not measured biophysics.

backbone.name: none applicable
backbone.licence: paper is CC BY-NC 4.0, but there is no data to licence

integration.partner_dataset: AlphaFold DB (four protein accessions are cited) and PDB entry 1ANR
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Cannot be written usefully: with one RNA and four crowder proteins there is nothing to join at a scale that would answer any question, so the join is decoration.

controls.positive_control: In principle the arginine/lysine enrichment at the RNA surface, which the paper itself reports, could serve as a known signal to recover — but only if trajectories were available.
controls.external_validation: None. No second source of crowded-RNA trajectories with matching composition exists that we located.

honest_claim_h3: No claim is possible: with five trajectories of one 52-nucleotide RNA and no released coordinates, any model would describe the behaviour of a single simulated molecule under one force field, not RNA behaviour in crowded cells.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the arrangement of crowding proteins around an RNA to predict where sodium ions and water sit on its surface
plain_idea.train_on: The project I considered would show the model local snapshots of one RNA hairpin plus the nearby protein or polymer crowders, and ask it to reproduce the solvation pattern. Number of genuinely independent examples: five simulation boxes.
plain_idea.predict: Per-nucleotide sodium ion occupancy and hydration-water residence time. The true answer comes from counting ions and waters in molecular dynamics trajectories, which are simulated numbers, not laboratory measurements.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Biophysicists who use polyethylene glycol as a stand-in for the cell interior would learn when that shortcut misleads them. But that is the paper's own conclusion, and no released data lets anyone build on it.

ml_idea: Considered and rejected: learn a mapping from local crowder environment to RNA ion condensation and hydration, so that cheap crowding descriptors could stand in for microsecond all-atom simulations. It dies because the trajectories that carry both the features and the labels were never deposited, and because five boxes containing one RNA molecule is not a dataset. The ion and hydration labels are also force-field outputs computed from the same coordinates that would be the features, which is leakage by construction.

effort.compute_note: Nothing estimated or timed, because no files were obtainable. Regenerating equivalent trajectories would need microseconds of all-atom molecular dynamics on crowded boxes, which is GPU-months and outside the laptop-only constraint.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Read the data availability statement and grep the full text for a repository link — two minutes, and it kills the project: the statement points only at the article's own figures and supplementary tables.

verdict_reason: No data is released (A1): the availability statement points only to the article's figures and supplementary material, and the full text contains no repository link. Even if trajectories appeared, the independent sample size is five simulation boxes of a single 52-nucleotide RNA (A5), there is no label column (A2), and every candidate label is computed from the same force-field coordinates that would be the features (A8). This is a well-executed biophysics simulation paper that produces a mechanistic conclusion, not a dataset.
